_comment_voice_enabled: If false, Nova skips loading Vosk/the microphone entirely and instead takes typed commands in the transcript window. Set to true once you're ready to test wake-word listening again.
_comment_tts_enabled: If false, Nova stays silent and just prints/logs replies instead of speaking them aloud. Set to true to hear Nova talk again.
_comment_use_ai_brain: If true (default) and the OPENAI_API_KEY environment variable is set, commands go to GPT (gpt-5-mini) for interpretation before falling back to offline pattern matching. Set to false to force offline-only mode even with a key set.
_comment_apps: Add any app you want Nova to be allowed to open. key = the word you'll say, value = full path to the .exe (or just the exe name if it's on PATH, like notepad.exe)
_comment_folders: Add any folder you want Nova to be allowed to open in File Explorer.
_comment_repos: Repos Nova can open Claude Code in. key = the word you'll say, value = the repo's root folder. This is Nova's most powerful capability by far - the launched session has full read/write access to whatever's in that folder, so only add repos you're comfortable with an AI coding agent having full access to.
_comment_memory_enabled: If true, Nova can save short notes about you (preferences, facts) and recall them in future sessions - its only write capability besides download_file. Off by default so this is an explicit opt-in, same as voice_enabled/tts_enabled.
_comment_memory_path: Where Nova's memory file lives. Relative paths resolve inside the project folder; point this at a file inside your Obsidian vault (e.g. an absolute path ending in '...\YourVault\Nova\memory.md') to keep memories there instead. Append-only - edit the file by hand anytime to correct or remove something.
_comment_discord_enabled: If true (and DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN is set as an environment variable), Nova runs a Discord bot as a third input/output channel alongside voice and the dashboard. Off by default - requires setting up a bot in the Discord Developer Portal first, see README.
_comment_discord_owner_id: Your Discord user ID - the only account whose messages Nova ever treats as commands, checked in code before anything reaches GPT. Enable Developer Mode in Discord (Settings -> Advanced), then right-click your name -> Copy User ID.
_comment_discord_guild_id: The one Discord server Nova is allowed to manage (create/rename/delete channels, send/delete messages). Right-click the server icon -> Copy Server ID. Nova will not act in any other server even if the bot is added to one.
